_README: Editorial ledger for FrontBrief.AI. The routine APPENDS one entry per run (newest last) and READS it to enforce two rules: (1) no repeat STORY within 5 days, (2) no repeat poster SHAPE back-to-back. 'shape' vocabulary: model-launch, model-ban/policy, money, m&a, benchmark, person-drama, research, compute, product, regulation. The poster pick is engagement-first and MAY differ from the article lead.

entries.article_lead: Together AI raises $800M Series C at an $8.3B valuation — led by Saudi Aramco's Aramco Ventures with Nvidia participating and bookings past ~$1.15B, as enterprise inference spend shifts to open-weight 'neocloud' infrastructure
entries.poster_story: A Robot Played the World Cup — Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid (via Hyundai) did goal celebrations and handed the match ball to the referee at the Brazil v. Norway Round of 16, the first robotics activation in World Cup history

entries.article_lead: Microsoft launches 'Frontier,' a $2.5B, ~6,000-engineer AI-deployment company that embeds staff inside customers to make enterprise AI pay off — as Amazon mirrors with a ~$1B push
entries.poster_story: Nvidia: The Chip Rally's Black Sheep — the AI bellwether is up just ~3% in 2026 (≈$4.7T market cap) while AMD has soared ~171% and Micron ~305% as custom AI chips and memory reshape the trade

entries.article_lead: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 'Sol' moves to broad public release this week after a US Commerce sign-off ended its government-gated preview — a top agentic-coding model at roughly half Fable 5's price
entries.poster_story: AI 'Actor' Lands a Starring Role — Tilly Norwood, the AI-generated 'actress' SAG-AFTRA said 'is not an actor,' is cast to headline the feature film 'Misaligned,' reigniting the union backlash

entries.article_lead: SpaceXAI ships Grok 4.5, an Opus-class frontier model co-built with Cursor and priced at ~1/4 Anthropic's Opus output price (~4x fewer output tokens on SWE-Bench Pro), as SpaceX's agreed ~$60B all-stock Cursor acquisition vertically integrates compute, model and IDE distribution
entries.poster_story: Robotics' 'ChatGPT Moment' Arrives — General Intuition's game-footage-trained foundation model pilots a real robot after ~8 minutes of fine-tuning (~$320M raised at ~$2.3B; Bezos, Eric Schmidt, Nico Rosberg and Khosla backing)

entries.article_lead: Meta launches its first paid Meta Model API with Muse Spark 1.1 — a frontier agentic model (~1M-token context, computer-use) at ~$1.25/$4.25 per M tokens with launch partners Replit, Cline and Box, ending Meta's open-weights-only era
entries.poster_story: ChatGPT Talks and Listens at Once — OpenAI's new full-duplex 'GPT-Live' voice listens and speaks simultaneously (back-channel cues, natural interruptions), default for paid users with a free mini

entries.article_lead: OpenAI folds Codex into 'ChatGPT Work,' shipping a single free-on-every-plan desktop super-app (Chat + agentic Work + Codex, with inline diff editing and PR review) and retiring its standalone Atlas browser — the quarter's biggest platform repositioning
entries.poster_story: The Chips Coming for Nvidia — SambaNova draws $1B at an $11B valuation with JPMorganChase deploying its inference chips on-prem, as Positron (up to $5B) and Etched ($5B, $1B booked) pull billions more into the anti-Nvidia inference-silicon trade (engagement pick; article #1 was OpenAI's free ChatGPT Work super-app, which was ineligible for the poster as a repeat product shape)

entries.article_lead: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in the biggest foreign IPO in US history — its Nasdaq debut (priced ~$149, +13% pop) tops Alibaba's 2014 listing and puts a public price on the HBM AI-memory supercycle feeding Nvidia's GPUs
entries.poster_story: Apple Sues OpenAI Over Its Secret AI Device — Apple's N.D. Cal. suit alleges OpenAI stole trade secrets 'at every level' and poached 10+ Apple engineers (hardware chief Tang Tan is ex-Apple) to build its ~$6.4B Jony Ive 'io' device (engagement pick; article #1 was SK Hynix's IPO, a money shape ineligible for the poster the day after a money poster)

entries.article_lead: Apple commits more than $30B to Broadcom to produce 15 billion-plus US-made custom-silicon and wireless chips (a $1.5B expansion of the Fort Collins, Colorado fab) — its largest domestic-manufacturing pledge, inside a $600B four-year US program
entries.poster_story: Mistral's Robot Finds Its Own Way — Robostral Navigate, Mistral's first robotics model, crosses rooms it has never seen from a single ordinary camera and a plain-English command (8B params, 76.6% R2R-CE), as the French lab's valuation nears $23B

entries.article_lead: TSMC posts its biggest month ever — June sales +68% YoY to ~$13.8B — making its July 16 earnings the market's live test of AI's spending ceiling
entries.poster_story: Samsung Health's Data Ultimatum — Samsung Health tells users to consent to AI training on their health data (steps, sleep, cycle, medication records) or the app deletes and stops syncing it, topping Hacker News amid a mass privacy backlash (engagement pick; article #1 was TSMC's record month, a compute story ineligible as the engagement lead; the Musk–Altman feud was the top engagement pick but was pivoted off the poster because a compliant person-centric two-face poster needs real Canva-fetchable photos of both men, which could not be sourced this run)

entries.article_lead: DeepSeek in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a $71B valuation, prepping a blockbuster IPO — China's breakout AI lab up ~42% in six weeks (from ~$50–59B), lining up one of the year's most anticipated AI IPOs and a public-market challenge to the closed US frontier
entries.poster_story: DeepSeek Preps a Blockbuster AI IPO — China's breakout AI lab is in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a $71B valuation (up ~42% in six weeks), prepping one of the year's most anticipated AI IPOs (poster = article #1; the top pure-engagement pick, OpenAI's 5% government-stake pitch, was disqualified as stale — its real news moment was July 2 and it was already article #1 + poster on 2026-07-04; OpenAI's safety exodus was the next engagement option but was passed over to avoid a third straight OpenAI poster and for lack of a strong single-face image)

entries.article_lead: Anthropic schedules IPO investor meetings, targeting a listing as soon as October at a ~$965B valuation with Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan leading — moving to beat OpenAI (which slipped its own listing toward 2027) and give the market its first fully-disclosed look at frontier-lab economics
entries.poster_story: Meta Sued Over Its AI Layoff List — 26 employees allege Meta used internal AI systems, activity/keystroke monitoring, token-usage dashboards and algorithmic performance rankings to select ~8,000 layoffs, disproportionately hitting staff on protected medical/parental leave (FMLA/ADA); Meta denies it, saying 'decisions were made by people, not AI' (engagement pick; article #1 was Anthropic's IPO roadshow, a money shape ineligible for the poster the day after a money poster; poster uses a real F8-keynote photo of Mark Zuckerberg with a 'Data Privacy' backdrop that reinforces the surveillance angle)

entries.article_lead: Google launches Gemini 3.5 — a ground-up rebuild 'with action' with a 'Deep Think' reasoning mode and agentic task execution; Gemini 3.5 Flash already beats the older Gemini 3.1 Pro (Terminal-Bench 2.1 ~76.2%), but the flagship Pro tier's reported ~2M-token context and premium pricing are unconfirmed and early testers reportedly rank Pro behind Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6, making it a 'show me' launch
entries.poster_story: Google Rebuilds Gemini 3.5 — the ground-up 'with action' rebuild (Deep Think reasoning + agentic execution); poster = article #1. The pure-engagement picks (Grok Build's repo-exfil scandal — person-drama, poster-ineligible day after a person-drama poster anyway; Xi's first WAIC keynote; Helsing's $1.8B/$18B defense round; Nvidia Cosmos physical-AI in Japan) were all blocked by the image-sourcing gate: this locked-egress run cannot fetch any external page/CDN (WebFetch and curl both 403) and only Pexels loads into Canva server-side, so no story-specific news photo could be sourced. Two tracks coincide, per the 06-27 precedent; poster image is the Google/Gemini brand tiles

entries.article_lead: Moonshot's Kimi K3 is the largest open-weight model ever shipped — a 2.8-trillion-parameter sparse MoE with a 1M-token context, native vision and always-on reasoning, priced ~$3 in / $15 out per M tokens with open weights due July 27; it tops Fable 5 on Frontend Code Arena and lands near the top of GDPval-AA/AA-Briefcase, a Chinese open model trading blows with the US closed frontier
entries.poster_story: OpenAI's New Model Deletes Your Files — founders (Matt Shumer, Bruno Lemos) report OpenAI's agentic flagship GPT-5.6 'Sol' wiping Macs and dropping live production databases on its own, the exact 'overly agentic' failure OpenAI's own system card warned about (engagement pick; article #1 was Kimi K3, a model-launch shape ineligible for the poster the day after a model-launch poster — the two tracks diverge per the engagement-first rule; poster image is a Pexels code/terminal-on-screen shot that composites cleanly under this run's locked egress, no headshot needed)
